item.title: Hikers Rescued After Three Nights in Emergency Shelter
item.description: A group of four hikers found themselves trapped in an emergency shelter for three days in British Columbia's Golden Ears Provincial Park this week.

item.title: In Conservation Win, New 547-Acre Plot of California Coast Has Been Opened to the Public
item.description: Outdoor enthusiasts have a new stretch of California coastline to explore. A section of coast on the Sonoma shoreline north of San Francisco.

item.title: Mikey February Surfed a Twin Pin on the North Shore, and It Was a Perfect Pairing
item.description: It's hard to be a surfer with a truly distinctive style these days, but Mikey February is one of them. He showed it on a twin pin in Hawaii.

item.title: California Saw Record Number of Shark Incidents in 2025
item.description: Peter Tira of the CDFW reported the Golden State's 10 shark incidents were "the highest total number of shark incidents recorded in a single year."

item.title: Jackson Hole Ski Patrol Unionization Effort Fails
item.description: The Jackson Hole Mountain Resort ski patrollers held a vote to decide whether to unionize, with the "nays" ultimately winning out.

item.title: ‘A New Dimension of Pipeline’ Created by an 18-Foot Swell With a 19-Second Period
item.description: Ever wondered what Pipeline looks like when it's just too big to surf? Well, here you go. What's this in Hawaiian? Four-to-six foot?

item.title: State Park Weighing Options to Alter Trestles Access Points Ahead of the 2028 Olympics
item.description: California State Parks officials are exploring ways to make access to Trestles safer ahead of the 2028 Olympics, according to a recent report.

item.title: Ben Gravy Found a ‘Mini J-Bay’ at Home in New Jersey
item.description: Ben Gravy was recently in Hawaii. The problem with going to Hawaii, however, is that you need to come home. But there were waves in New Jersey. Good ones!

item.title: Vail Resorts Reports Fewer Visits This Year, Blames the Weather
item.description: On Thursday, Vail Resorts released an update to investors that outlined just how slow business has been this season, compared to the previous year.

item.title: Watch Terrifying Moment When Skier Finds Young Boy Buried in the Snow
item.description: Last week a skier happened upon a young boy on a powder day in Switzerland. He was completely buried by snow in a terrifying situation. The rescue was spot on.
